purpose: Редакция для обсуждения нового текста: фиксированная точка обзора, лужа во всю дорожку, видимый обход по траве.
frames: Вова стоит перед лужей, которая перекрывает дорожку. Качели видны за лужей.
С той же точки обзора: Вова идёт по траве в обход той же лужи. Качели остаются на прежнем месте.
prompt:

Edit target and character/style reference: the attached two-panel park illustration. Correct the spatial continuity and make the boy's bypass of the puddle visible. Keep Vova's recognizable identity exactly: blond hair, blue eyes, blue short-sleeved T-shirt, navy trousers, red sneakers. Preserve the warm, polished softly shaded children's illustration style. No other children or adults.
Produce ONE exact 2:1 landscape canvas made of TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side, split at the exact vertical midpoint. No gutter, no lines, no borders, no captions, words, arrows, numbers, labels, maps, motion lines or watermarks. Normal opaque background; rounded corners will be added by the layout later.
CRITICAL FIX — ONE LOCKED CAMERA VIEW: Build one simple park environment for the left panel, then COPY THE ENTIRE SAME ENVIRONMENT into the right panel with the SAME camera position, angle, scale and crop. Change ONLY the boy's position and walking pose. The path, puddle, swing, trees and grass must have the SAME geometry, sizes and screen coordinates within each square. This is a fixed camera, NOT two reverse angles, NOT a zoom or close-up. The swing must stay in the BACKGROUND BEYOND the puddle in BOTH panels. The puddle must stay in the SAME foreground/middle-ground location in BOTH panels. Remove the bench from BOTH panels entirely.
FIXED WORLD LAYOUT in each square: A broad sandy footpath leads from the bottom center towards the same playground swing in the upper-center/right distance. There are clearly defined green grass verges on BOTH sides of the path. One LARGE puddle lies ACROSS THE ENTIRE WIDTH of the sandy path, from its left grass verge right up to its right grass verge. There is absolutely NO DRY STRIP OF PATH beside this puddle: to pass it without stepping in water, the boy has to leave the sandy path and walk on the grass. Make this physical obstacle unmistakable. The same two-seat wooden A-frame swing with grey top rail and black seats is visible beyond the puddle in the distance, with the same size and position in both squares. Minimal simple trees and bushes in the background, grass near the path, sparse visual detail. No distracting flower carpet.
LEFT SQUARE — BEFORE the obstacle: Vova stands on the DRY SANDY PATH on the near side of the full-width puddle, looking toward the puddle and the swing beyond it. Keep his whole body visible. The puddle completely blocks the continuation of the sandy path ahead of him. His red sneakers are dry and do not touch the water. Natural neutral attentive pose, not a dramatic or worried expression.
RIGHT SQUARE — THE BYPASS ACTION: In the EXACT SAME FIXED VIEW, Vova has stepped off the sandy path onto the GREEN GRASS at the LEFT SIDE of the SAME puddle and is visibly WALKING AROUND it toward the far dry section of path and the swing. Show a clear gentle walking stride, one foot forward and one behind, both shoes entirely over the grass OUTSIDE the water and OUTSIDE the sandy path at this point. The boy is alongside the puddle near its far left edge, making his grassy route visually obvious. He is NOT on the swing and NOT holding its chains. Do not move the puddle behind the swing or change the order of objects. Background must match the left panel as a continuous location.
Frame comfortably: all of Vova, both shoes, the whole puddle's banks and the full swing must fit inside EACH square without crossing the central seam. Keep key objects and the boy at least 5% away from each square's outer edges when feasible. No duplicated child in a panel. No jumping, no stepping in the puddle, no wet footprints, no visible route arrows, no extra story elements.
